title: Synthetic example: scratch volume full on Linux build workers
summary: Linker could not write output because the worker scratch volume had no space left.
recommendation: Prune stale build directories on the worker and confirm the nightly cleanup job runs.
evidence: 2026-10-22T10:14:16Z [ERROR] linker output could not be written: no space left on device
2026-10-22T10:14:16Z [ERROR] worker filesystem is full while creating compiler output
root_cause: The nightly scratch cleanup job was disabled, so stale build directories filled the volume.

fix.description: Re-enabled the nightly scratch cleanup job and added a disk-usage alert at 85%.
fix.validation_evidence: Synthetic example: 5 consecutive nightly builds passed with scratch usage below 60%.
